title: Log screen help blurb restates LOG_FILE_COUNT and LOG_FILE_LIMIT by hand
notes: src/renderer/keys/help.ts:394 says 'five files of 5 MB' while LOG_FILE_COUNT and LOG_FILE_LIMIT live in src/shared/app/log-entry.ts and log-store.ts enforces them. Cost: change either constant and the help dialog keeps promising the old numbers. Fix: export LOG_FILE_LIMIT_SHOWN beside LOG_FILE_LIMIT (as chat-pdf.ts derives PDF_LIMIT_SHOWN) and build the blurb from it and LOG_FILE_COUNT. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/148 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/143#discussion_r4435518511

comments.body: PR #152: help blurb built from LOG_FILE_COUNT and new LOG_FILE_LIMIT_SHOWN (tested); log-store comments name the constants; v2.32.13.
Shipped in #152: the log screen's help blurb is built from LOG_FILE_COUNT and LOG_FILE_LIMIT.
